subject: Staffing cadence sync — Q1 role prioritization & offer timing
messages:
From: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@talentbridge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q1 candidate pipeline / proposed offer cadence

Hi Vanessa —

Attached is the updated Q1 pipeline snapshot (pipeline_snapshot_Q1.xlsx). A few quick highlights for the roles we've been moving:
- 3 final-stage candidates for Platform Infra (two green, one needs manager touchpoints)
- 1 strong IC candidate for Model Serving (comp discussion pending)
- 2 backfills on the Product org: late-stage offers pending approval

Questions for the hiring stakeholders:
1) Are we green to extend offers this week for the two Product backfills, or do you prefer to stagger?
2) For Platform Infra, hiring manager asked if we can prioritize two backfills and hold the third until budget confirmation — do you have a preference?

If useful, I can convert the snapshot into a one‑pager for the QBR.

Thanks —
Elaine Wong
Senior Account Manager, TalentBridge
elaine.wong@talentbridge.com
Attachment: pipeline_snapshot_Q1.xlsx

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 candidate pipeline / proposed offer cadence

Team — looping you in on Elaine's snapshot (below). High‑level ask: we need to decide which reqs to push to offers now vs. pause until Q1 QBR budget confirmation. My recommendations:

- Priority A (extend now): 2 Product backfills (hiring manager has headcount approved for replacement; impact to roadmap if delayed).
- Priority B (stagger): 2 Platform Infra backfills — prioritize the two with most uptime impact, hold the third until we confirm DRI for headcount or shift to contractor.
- Priority C (hold): Model Serving IC — comp range needs alignment with CompOps; push one week.

Please reply with your decisions and any redlines. If we can lock decisions by Monday EOD, recruiting can land offers by EOW and we can include the final counts in Monday's QBR prep doc.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Talent Partnering, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 candidate pipeline / proposed offer cadence

+1 to Vanessa's split. Quick notes from infra POV:
- We need both infra backfills immediately (service reliability exposures if we lose bench). I'll advocate for extending offers to the two strongest candidates.
- For the third infra candidate, suggest "pause to freeze" unless we get explicit budget commitment by next Wednesday. If frozen, recruiting can reclassify to contract hire.

Attaching a short impact memo for QBR (infra-impact-memo.pdf) quantifying uptime risk and oncall capacity if we delay.

Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Engineering
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: infra-impact-memo.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 candidate pipeline / proposed offer cadence

Thanks — agree with prioritization. Two operational points:
1) Hiring manager bandwidth: If we push both Product backfills and two Infra offers in the same week, managers will struggle to do reference checks and final interviews. Suggest staggering Product offers by 3 business days.
2) Offer approvals: Finance has limited headroom in Jan; if a role needs comp above midpoint, it will require a manager-level justification. Please flag any candidates who need comp uplift.

FWIW, I think we can land 3 offers this month without impacting onboarding schedule if we stagger.

Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 candidate pipeline / proposed offer cadence

Thanks for pulling this together. Decisions:
- APPROVE: Product backfills (2) — extend offers, but stagger as Laura recommended (Product A: offer Tues 20 Jan, Product B: offer Fri 23 Jan).
- APPROVE (conditional): Infra backfills (2) — extend offers this week for the two candidates Marcus identified. Finance has asked we keep offers within the published bands; if any candidate requires uplift, coordinate with me before extending.
- HOLD: Infra candidate #3 — freeze until we clear budget at QBR or convert to 3-month contract.
- Model Serving IC: delay comp finalization by 1 week; Recruiting please queue but don't extend.

Elaine — please confirm you can land the two Infra offers by EOD Friday and schedule Product offer windows as above. Also update the QBR headcount slide with the final counts; I'll bring this to the leadership check-in.

Aditya Rao
VP, Engineering (Hiring Approver)
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
